description: This file defines the EmpDependentDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the EmpDependent entity, providing additional methods for formatting data and managing relationships related to employee dependents within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmpDependentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds additional functionalities to the EmpDependent entity, such as formatted date retrieval and relationship management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmpDependent entity instance.

methods.name: getEmpDependent
methods.description: Protected method to access the underlying EmpDependent entity.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns the employee dependent's date of birth formatted as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee with the dependent entity based on the employee number.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Returns a human-readable relationship description, considering special cases like 'Other'.
